pamphlet_excerpts: Roles A Veterinarian Plays: Laboratory animal medicine and research veterinary medicinehave much in common (p. 30).
Roles A Veterinarian Plays Principle 2: Both fields apply the skills learned inveterinary school to a number of areas of study (p. 30).
Roles A Veterinarian Plays Principle 3: A veterinarian working in laboratory animal medicineprovides medical care for animals used in research (p. 30).
Roles A Veterinarian Plays Principle 4: The veterinarian sometimes is a member of the research team and helps design studies, interpret results, and publish articles about the research (p. 30).
step_by_step_procedure: Step 1 (Roles A Veterinarian Plays): Research veterinarians investigate new medicines, biotechnical and diagnostic tests, food technologies, and other newtechnologies (p. 30).
Step 2 (Roles A Veterinarian Plays): Research veterinarians might also investigate theexotic and infectious diseases that threaten public health (p. 30).
Step 3 (Roles A Veterinarian Plays): Or, research veterinarians might work in the emerging field of genetic research (p. 30).
Step 4 (Roles A Veterinarian Plays): Laboratory animal medicine and research veterinarians usually work on a team of scientists, much like an individual Scout works (p. 30).
